about: Frances's monthly subscription: the Clinic Content Plan subscription, £27 a month (2026-11-20: the only thing the engine ever promotes). The design features have their own monthly code in the Engine Extras classroom (design_features_classroom) but are never promoted or sold in the engine. The engine comes with the Starter Plan (the first 30 days). Each month's content plan goes live on drop_day (the 23rd) for the month after, unlocked with a code posted in the members' classroom. From promo_day (the 20th), anyone who isn't signed up is told once that it's dropping on the 23rd and can join now (status.py's PROMO line); from the 23rd, anyone who hasn't unlocked the new plan is asked once whether they've got their code (status.py's OFFER line). On a yes to joining, Claude gives them the checkout link. The first monthly plan is January 2027's (first_monthly_plan; Frances, 2026-11-23: there's no December plan, because the Starter Plan's 30 days carry everyone to the January drop), so nothing is promoted or asked for before it.
name: the Clinic Content Plan subscription
what_they_get: a brand new content plan every month, made for the treatments you do (laser, skin, aesthetics, body, PMU, lashes and brows, hair, nails or beauty), which unlocks in your engine with a code to make your next month
how_to_join: Once you've joined, your code for each month's plan is posted in the Content Plan Members classroom in the community: you type it into your engine and your new plan unlocks.
